title: Loops
summary: Repeat work with for and while loops.

exercises.title: Count to Five
exercises.prompt: Print the numbers 1 to 5, one per line.

exercises.title: Sum to 100
exercises.prompt: Print the sum of the numbers 1 to 100.
hints: Start total at 0 and add each i.
exercises.solution:
total = 0
for i in range(1, 101):
    total += i
print(total)

exercises.title: Evens on One Line
exercises.prompt: Print the even numbers from 2 to 20 on ONE line, separated by single spaces.
hints: print(*list) prints items separated by spaces.

exercises.title: Countdown
exercises.prompt: Print `5` down to `1` one per line, then `Liftoff!`.
exercises.solution:
n = 5
while n > 0:
    print(n)
    n -= 1
print("Liftoff!")

exercises.title: Factorial
exercises.prompt: Read an integer n (0 or more). Print n factorial (n!). 0! is 1.
hints: Multiply result by each number from 2 to n.
exercises.solution:
n = int(input())
result = 1
for i in range(2, n + 1):
    result *= i
print(result)

exercises.title: Sum Until Zero
exercises.prompt: Read integers one per line until `0` is entered. Print the sum of all numbers before the 0.
exercises.solution:
total = 0
while True:
    n = int(input())
    if n == 0:
        break
    total += n
print(total)

exercises.title: First Match
exercises.prompt: Find and print the first number from 1 to 100 that is divisible by both 6 and 8.

exercises.title: Skip Multiples of 3
exercises.prompt: Print the numbers 1 to 10, one per line, but skip multiples of 3.
hints: continue skips the rest of the loop body.

exercises.title: Star Triangle
exercises.solution:
for i in range(1, 5):
    print("*" * i)

exercises.title: Times Table
exercises.prompt: Read an integer n. Print its times table from 1 to 10, one line each, like `7 x 1 = 7`.
hints: Use an f-string inside a for loop.

quiz.question: Which keyword exits a loop early?
What does continue do?
quiz.explanation: It jumps to the next iteration.

quiz.question: How many times does 'for i in range(3): print(i)' print?
